documents.title: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Safe Enterprises Retail Fixtures reported a transformative FY26 with significant growth across revenue, EBITDA, and PAT, driven by new store rollouts and repeat refurbishment orders on a 3 to 4-year cycle. The company launched two new product lines, WAVE (RFID self-checkout) and EVOLV (standardized engineering for home interiors), while construction for the Ambernath plant is underway and on track for a Q3 FY27 completion. Management highlighted strong balance sheet health, expanding manufacturing footprints, and an increased average revenue per store due to higher fixture intensity, premium finishes, and richer product mixes. Safe Enterprises Retail Fixtures Limited reported its consolidated financial and operational results for FY26, highlighting a revenue increase alongside expanded manufacturing capacities in Pune and Ambernath. Management noted growth driven by enhanced revenue intensity per store, higher fixture volumes, and repeat refurbishment cycles.

guidance.claim: Management stated that on a long-term basis, a 25% PAT margin should be considered reasonable.
guidance.quote: See, on a long-term basis, whenever I am asked kind of a guidance, I always say that 25% is something that you should consider on a long-term basis.

guidance.claim: Management provided a top-line guidance above INR400 crores and INR100 crores PAT for FY28.
guidance.quote: The guidance that I give is above INR400 crores and INR100 crores PAT.

guidance.claim: The company expects healthy double-digit growth for FY26.
guidance.quote: The company expects healthy double-digit growth for FY’26, supported by the ongoing expansion of organized retail across India, recent capacity enhancements, and increasing demand from both domestic and international clients.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that retail rollouts as a whole are on an increase, and the company is taking its share of the pie from that increase.
demand_outlook.quote: So, the number of stores rollout as retail as a whole, I think is on an increase. So, we are taking a share -- our share of the pie from that increase.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the company is well positioned to sustain growth, supported by increasing outsourcing by organized retailers and continued demand for innovative retail fixture and fit-out solutions across key consumption categories.
demand_outlook.quote: Well positioned to sustain growth, supported by increasing outsourcing by organized retailers and continued demand for innovative retail fixture and fit-out solutions across key consumption categories.

demand_outlook.claim: Export orders have increased, supported by new partnerships in the Middle East.
demand_outlook.quote: • Export orders: Increased, supported by new partnerships in the Middle East.

demand_outlook.claim: Rising investments in retail infrastructure and new store formats are expected to further strengthen demand and sustain growth momentum.
demand_outlook.quote: Rising investments in retail infrastructure and new store formats are expected to further strengthen demand and sustain growth momentum in the coming quarters.

capex_expansion.claim: The total capex for the plant is around INR75 crores and around INR14 odd crores for machinery, totaling around INR90 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: So, the total as given in the offer document is around INR75 crores for the plant and I think around INR14 odd crores for the machinery, totalling to around INR90 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The Ambernath plant size was increased to 2,50,000 square feet by re-engineering the plant style and utilizing a basement and FSI allowance.
capex_expansion.quote: Originally, we were going to make 1,75,000 square feet, but we have been able to make 2,50,000 square feet by re-engineering our plant style, also doing a basement and things like that and optimizing our FSI allowance.

capex_expansion.claim: The Company expanded its Pune manufacturing facility by 46,505 sq. ft. in March 2026, increasing total facility area from 50,000 sq. ft. to 96,505 sq. ft.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company expanded its Pune manufacturing facility by 46,505 sq. ft. in March 2026, increasing the total facility area from 50,000 sq. ft. to 96,505 sq. ft.

capex_expansion.claim: The new Ambernath plant with 250,000 sq.ft. capacity remains on track for completion by December 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: The new Ambernath plant with 250,000 sq.ft. capacity remains on track for completion by December 2026.

capex_expansion.claim: Post completion of the Ambernath plant, existing leased Mumbai facilities of 96,425 sq.ft. will be consolidated into the new plant.
capex_expansion.quote: Post completion, the existing leased Mumbai facilities of 96,425 sq.ft. will be consolidated into the new plant, driving higher efficiency and future scalability.

capex_expansion.claim: The company added one leased facility in Mumbai and expanded the Pune facility by 46505 square feet.
capex_expansion.quote: Capacity expansion: Addition of one leased facility in Mumbai and further expanded Pune facility by 46505 sq.f.t. to support scalable operations till the opening of Ambernath Plant.

capex_expansion.claim: Interim capacity enhancement measures included the reconfiguration of production layouts to improve throughput efficiency.
capex_expansion.quote: 1.Reconfiguration of production layouts to improve throughput efficiency.

capex_expansion.claim: Process streamlining was implemented to reduce turnaround time and improve output consistency.
capex_expansion.quote: 3.Process streamlining to reduce turnaround time and improve output consistency.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that lease rentals act as a cash cost that will not exist once the company moves to its own plant.
margins_costs.quote: So again, the lease rentals are something that becomes a cash cost against which once we move to our own plant, this will again not be there.

margins_costs.claim: Management believes there is scope for immediate margin improvement due to the elimination of inherent inefficiencies and internal transportation costs from multiple plants.
margins_costs.quote: So, I think on an immediate basis, there is scope of margin improvement, but on a long-term basis, I think 25.00% is something that I think we should consider reasonable.

margins_costs.claim: Expanded manufacturing capacity is being increasingly utilized, driving higher throughput and enhancing operating leverage.
margins_costs.quote: Expanded manufacturing capacity is being increasingly utilized, driving higher throughput and enhancing operating leverage.

margins_costs.claim: Improved realization more than offset the modest decline in store installations, highlighting management's focus on maximizing value per project rather than pursuing volume-led growth.
margins_costs.quote: Improved realization more than offset the modest decline in store installations, highlighting management’s focus on maximizing value per project rather than pursuing volume-led growth.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin was sustained at 39.6%, supported by improved capacity utilization and operating leverage.
margins_costs.quote: • EBITDA margin sustained at 39.6%, supported by improved capacity utilization and operating leverage.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin was 39.6% in H1 FY26 versus 41.5% in H1 FY25.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA Margin: 39.6 % versus 41.5 % in H1 FY’25
